# LF3-R1 pre-repair ownership snapshots

`lf3-r1-seed-5.json.gz` and `lf3-r1-seed-77.json.gz` were captured using the
published `4cc5e3c` native extension, before the route repair. The isolated
fixture gathers real generated timber, pays for a cube overlapping the second
old collection mark and performs one unit of Red source work. No normal user
save or supplied inventory is involved. Complete original finite-node ledgers,
source claims, machinery identity, economy and construction are retained.

These are ordinary schema-2 JSON snapshots compressed with standard gzip.
The route regression expands each into its ignored build directory, restores
it twice through SaveManager and compares exact owned state. Its two geography
hashes were captured before repair from the engine's complete map dictionary,
excluding only derived LF paths and presentation tuning. The independent native
37-seed fingerprints additionally cover every terrain voxel.

To reproduce the failing movement on the old build, run
`living_frontier_routes.tscn -- --route-seed=5 --lf3-r1-baseline` and repeat with
seed 77. The unmodified controller uses normal walking and Space jump input;
it stops at the real back walls at segments 256 and 233 respectively.
